calendar.eventTitle: When Love Doesn't Feel Like Enough: Understanding Attachment, Behavior, and Healing
calendar.eventDescription: This presentation explores how early experiences shape attachment, why behavior is often a form of communication, and how trauma can influence a child's brain, body, and relationships. Participants will gain practical, trauma-informed strategies to better understand challenging behaviors, strengthen connection, and foster healing, and are introduced to the science of epigenetics.
